Byte-identical to frozen template rules/projects/webdev-task-template/tests/scoring.toml (sha256 95f70d6e...bbba both); tests/tools/score.py (13de2b38...c04e) and tests/test.sh (bd682592...5aa) also byte-identical to the template, so no shared harness/reward policy was altered (lesson 2 satisfied: weights untouched). (2) Gates zero reward and skip scored suite: score.py:40-48 computes gates_passed = all(score > 0.0); scored dims forced to 0.0 unless gates_passed; reward = 0.0 unless gates_passed and floors_passed; returns exit 1 on gate failure (score.py:83). test.sh:212-222 removes any old scored dir, runs gates suite (budget 1500), runs score.py; exit 1 -> 'exit 0' before run_suite scored (line 224), so the scored suite never runs; exit >=2 -> write_zero_reward; gates suite crash/timeout -> exit 0 with the pre-written zero record (test.sh:60, trap ensure_reward). (3) Gates carry no weight: weighted sum (score.py:46) iterates only [weights]; gate scores appear in reward.json only as diagnostics. (4) Floor: score.py:47 floors_passed requires functional > 0.05 strictly. (5) Executed the frozen score.py (python -I -B, no workspace writes; synthetic RewardKit outputs in scratchpad): render=0 + perfect scored -> exit 1, reward 0.0, scored dims 0.0; constraints=0, no scored file -> exit 1, reward 0.0; gates pass but scored missing -> reward 0.0; functional 0.0492 (3/61) with polish=visual=1 -> reward 0.0 (weighted_score 0.4295 not paid); functional exactly 0.05 -> reward 0.0; functional 0.0574 (3.5/61), polish 0, visual 0.8 -> reward 0.1944; all-ones -> 1.0; gates pass, scored all 0 -> 0.0. (6) Gate dimensions: gates/render/judge.toml and gates/constraints/judge.toml each have aggregation='all_pass', one binary criterion, weight 1, no [judge] weight/model keys. Scored dims use weighted_mean (functional 44 criteria, total weight 61; polish 5/9.5; visual 5 likert/5). (7) 'Passing only the cheap gates earns little' (Internal Quality Checks sheet row 44): an app that passes both gates but nothing else can at most pass hro_add_candidate (weight 1/61 = 0.016 < 0.05) -> reward 0; polish/visual cannot be farmed. The in-dimension gate in scored/polish/prompt.md:11-12 and scored/visual/prompt.md:11-12 (visual: minimum raw Likert 1 -> normalized 0) repeats the server-backed check so a static shell scores 0 even if a gate judge erred. Lessons file check: lesson 4 (gates simple: load, reload, server-backed) holds - render gate = wrong/right password sign-in to a usable workspace; constraints gate = UI add candidate, reload, independent Observer readback; all other strictness is in scored criteria. Lesson 2 (no weight steering) holds. Lesson 11 (judge infra crash zeroes a dimension): a gate-suite crash yields reward 0 by template design (test.sh:213-214) - template behaviour, not a task defect. Raw evidence index (qc/runs/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r2/raw-evidence-index.json) states full configured grading and reward discrimination/ranking runs are absent; this row's mechanics were exercised directly via score.py, but no full configured verifier run exercised the test.sh gate-fail branch end to end.

NOTE: Observation, not a defect: the template floor (0.05, template-controlled) lets a partially working app that clears both gates plus ~3.5/61 functional weight (e.g. add_candidate 1 + add_email_rules 1 + anonymous 1.5) collect visual/polish mass, e.g. reward 0.1944 with visual 0.8. Such an app is genuinely server-backed and partially functional, so this is the designed shaping, not a non-working app farming polish/visual; ranking monotonicity is row 42's concern. Tried counterexamples: (a) static/seed-copy shell - fails constraints gate (needs UI add + independent context readback) and in-dimension gates -> 0; (b) app passing only gates - functional 1/61 < floor -> 0; (c) conforming app whose gate judge crashes - zero by template design, would be an evaluator failure to report, not a rubric defect.
